investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (250) was observed from the user, far above the 24-hour baseline of 30. The activity originated from 210.138.184.59 to 40.108.201.15 using Office 365 SharePoint Online. Geo location shows Tokyo, Japan, while sample paths reference Tallinn, Estonia, indicating a geographic/path mismatch. The combination of high data volume and conflicting location signals points to a potential data exfiltration attempt or insider risk, thus classified as HP.
